facts.fact: INS Guinea and ICF's July 2019 report presents the fifth Demographic and Health Survey (EDS V), fielded March to June 2018 on a sample of about 8,000 households.
The EDS V report states its sampling frame is the database of the general population and housing census held in 2014 (RGPH 2014), which lists 9,679 enumeration areas.
